| `owned .7z holding the 4.6 GB DVD ISO (or .chd via chdman)` | ISO9660, PVD at sector 16; streamed by 7-Zip without unpacking | gbox/gta3_inventory.py, gbox/gta3_chars.py stream_entries | writers unpack once to the modbase cache (gta3_swap.iso_from_rom) |
| `MODELS/GTA3.DIR + GTA3.IMG and 11 byte-identical copies GTA3_1..GTA3_11.IMG` | DIR 32-byte {u32 offset sectors, u32 size sectors, char name[24]}; IMG packed without gaps | gbox/gta_rw.py | the streamer reads the copy nearest the head, so every replaced entry goes into all 12 |
| `*.dff / *.txd entries` | DFF = RenderWare 3.1 plain geometry (tristrip BinMesh), player clump 17 frames / 16 rigid atomics; TXD = PS2 TextureNative, 8-bit rasters PSMT8-swizzled, CSM1 palette, alpha 0x80 opaque | gbox/gta_rw.py (byte-identical round trip of every DFF/TXD) | peds animated by frame name from ANIM/PED.IFP; CUTS.IMG holds animation/speech/data, no model bank |

## Live replacement

**Live file swap: static only.** builds are separate ISOs (cold boot proven for the face build); the generic session_swap route exists but no in-session model file swap is proven

**Pick whip: partial.** characters DEDICATED_PICK gta3 -> gta3_chars.pick_entry: a centre pick with slot=player resolves to model 0, skin from a session RAM image (identify_skin) else default; other peds and vehicles return None. Replacement is a rebuild, not in-RAM.

**Live controls:** gta_mods (punch/explode, tank_rain, fast/flying cars, super_jump, heli, densities, giant, spawn_vehicle, car_jump, ped_rain); gta_live (pools, player, vehicles, weather, time, wanted, teleport, spawn); gta3_items sidebar; NATIVE allowlist: gta_mods ped_rain. No PS2 cheat path in cheats.py.
